CommercialIQ.summary: AI-powered commercial decision intelligence platform for demand forecasting, customer segmentation, predictive risk, commercial analytics, RAG and tool-using AI decision support.
CommercialIQ.data: Synthetic commercial dataset: 100 customers, 10 products, 1,500 transactions, 30 forecast records, 100 segment assignments, 100 risk outputs and 5 knowledge documents.
CommercialIQ.architecture: React/Vite UI -> Vercel Serverless Functions -> Supabase PostgreSQL; Python ML pipeline for forecasting/risk/segmentation; RAG/tool orchestration for AI analyst; deterministic fallback when optional AI is unavailable.
CommercialIQ.deloitteRelevance: Strong example of analytics, transformation, data-driven decision support, automation, AI governance and business value.

Skylark Command.summary: Trust-native executive decision intelligence over live CRM and operational data, with deterministic business analytics, Change Intelligence, Customer 360, Scenario Lab and bounded AI interpretation.
Skylark Command.architecture: monday.com GraphQL read-only data -> normalization/quality flags -> live and persisted snapshots -> deterministic analytics -> semantic registry + lineage -> typed analytical tools -> Copilot/Scenario Lab/UI; optional Gemini only interprets already-computed results.
Skylark Command.trust: FACT/ESTIMATE/INTERPRETATION separation, evidence/lineage, unknown stays unknown, read-only demo mode, schema/tool allowlists, RBAC foundation, prompt-injection defenses and structured redacted telemetry.
Skylark Command.deloitteRelevance: Strong example of enterprise workflows, stakeholder-facing analytics, data quality, explainability, systems integration and transformation-oriented decision support.

Koshora.summary: Production-minded personal-finance workspace connecting transactions, budgets, recurring commitments, accounts and savings goals with deterministic forecasting and explainable insights.
Koshora.architecture: Public recruiter demo uses localStorage; private cloud mode uses Supabase Auth, membership bootstrap, server-side read model and authenticated finance mutations. Seven finance tables are protected by membership + ownership RLS.
Koshora.deloitteRelevance: Strong finance-domain project showing data modeling, deterministic financial logic, security, explainability, isolation and product engineering.
